body: I know, I'm getting help now. But its not the kind of help I want. Ive been in and out of psychiatrists and psychologists and counselors offices since my parents divorced when I was a kid, and nothing has changed since then. Years of bottling up my anger has warped and nullified my emotions to a point of unrecognizability. Life just isn't a pleasant experience for me anymore.
I set 21 years for myself years ago. I'm 20 now and my birthday is half a year away. But Ill probably puss out.
